How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. After that, delivery to the contiguous U.S. typically takes 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, or 5–7 days to the East Coast.
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding holidays. You can check the latest estimates on our Shipping & Delivery page.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
We offer a 90-day manufacturer’s warranty for products bought directly from us. If an item arrives with a broken or defective part, or a part breaks during assembly, you don’t need to return the whole item—we provide replacement parts free of charge under the warranty. Damage from misuse or negligence isn’t covered, and items bought from third-party sellers are subject to those sellers’ policies.
You can submit a claim through our warranty portal.
